route: KIE generate-music (Skill 68 / 74 market createTask), custom mode

kie_params.duration: delivered seconds (L-2); G9 headroom question is open decision 3 in file 18

lyrics.built_by: suno_recipe.render_lyrics from the music style's length skeleton + the lyric writer's lines

style.built_by: music/<style>.json style_parts, joined in order; measured AFTER ending_qc appends the clean-ending clause

title.built_by: ad name, plain words, no brand-name claims

tag_grammar.cue_rule: short and concrete (file 17); delivery named in every tag; a cue never carries plot or lyric words
tag_grammar.multi_vocalist_form: [<Section> (<delivery>): Vocal A, <gender word from cast> voice, <cue>]
tag_grammar.multi_vocalist_rule: labels repeat in every tag that voice sings; gender word comes from the cast record (U5), never hard-coded; identity is NOT guaranteed (file 17), so qc_voice_match line_voice_fit is the judge

sung.vocalise: wordless, full melodic voice, two very long held notes
sung.verse: melodic, rhymed, slow long held notes
sung.hook: full melody, sustained notes, slow long held notes
sung.product: melodic, warm, clear diction on the name

spoken.intro: close dry voice, plain speech, no melody
spoken.outro: calm close voice, plain speech, no melody

rap.verse: tight rhythmic rap, conversational flow, clear diction

lyric_line_rules: sung lines 5-6 syllables aimed, 8 at most (suno_recipe.MAX_SUNG_LINE_SYLLABLES)
sung lines rhymed AABB, ending on open vowels where possible (go, me, high, slow), with hyphen-held vowels on the held word (ri-i-ise)
a wordless sung vocalise comes before the first hook; the first hook never starts at 0 s
the hook is pasted in full every time it is sung (never 'repeat chorus')
numbers and times as words in sung text ('nine A M'); brand words in a pronounceable sheet spelling, display spelling for captions (U8 map)
spoken text: short plain sentences, periods, no rhyme, no repetition (the contrast with the sung lines is the signal, file 09)
rap lines (R&B Flow only): 8-12 words per line, internal rhyme allowed, no line over 14 words

hook_formula.words: 4-10 of the client's own words (sung_hook.check_hook_text), protected names exact
hook_formula.shape: one line of 6-8 syllables, or two lines of 5-6, ending on an open vowel; the payoff / brand promise
hook_formula.placement: first by 15% of runtime, last near 90% (before the CTA), the rest evenly spaced (sung_hook.hook_times)

extend_rules: Extend is used ONLY to land a length one generation cannot reach (delivered > 300 s, length_formula.MAX_GEN_S) or to repair a take that came back short.

Request: model ai-music-api/extend, input {audio_id, continue_at = measured audio length - 30, model = the source take's model}. No duration field: measure the returned take and re-plan from its real length.
Same style text, vocal gender, tempo and key words on every segment; the extend lyrics carry only the sections not yet sung, with their own [Section (delivery)] tags.
Never extend for billing or to pad a short song: a short take is regenerated whole unless only the tail is missing.
replace_section_rules: LEARNED: KIE replace-section regenerates the TAIL from infillStartS, so it is never an in-place edit of a middle section.

Allowed only as a tail repair: the defect sits in the last part of the take, the regenerated region is at least 10 s and at most 50% of the original duration (68 catalog), and everything after infillStartS may change.

After any replace or extend, the WHOLE take is judged again by song_dispatch (singcheck, spoken share, sung of voice, 6 s stretch, hook count, script words, length, clean ending). A middle-section defect means regenerate the whole track.
